reviewer_role: Independent saved-data and static-source reviewer; no runtime edits or new timing workload.

explicit_cause_assessment.verified_work: The timer surrounds the fresh import of memory_book and MemoryBook. __init__ imports store; store imports segmentation/text and executes ordinary-json-loader certification. Candidate store.py grows from 61126 to 74966 bytes and adds class/function bodies. The workflow sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, and the sparse frozen source checkouts contain no generated Python bytecode.
explicit_cause_assessment.excluded_claims: The MCP stdio adapter is not executed in this interval; mcp_server.py and token_budget.py are not imported by store at this stage. No new model or third-party dependency load explains this metric.
explicit_cause_assessment.strength: Every one of the eight original cohort/round import comparisons is slower, by roughly three milliseconds. Added source compilation/initialization work is a code-supported contributor.
explicit_cause_assessment.uncertainty: No subphase attribution was measured. This review does not claim that source-size growth quantitatively explains the entire increase or that every installation will share this source-only import cost.

explicit_cause_assessment.verified_work: The timer measures construction of a fresh empty database before any corpus ingestion. Candidate adds pages_recall_metadata creation within SCHEMA, an idempotent CREATE INDEX check after schema setup, and PRAGMA cache_size=-4096, plus small per-book fields. This is additional initialization work, not retrieval or growth with public corpus size.
explicit_cause_assessment.strength: The four complete round pairs are retained. Candidate is slower in three and faster in one; the largest candidate opening is 39.683334ms. The largest round increase is not discarded.
explicit_cause_assessment.uncertainty: The saved measurements do not isolate DDL execution, filesystem/SQLite synchronization or scheduling contributions. The 14.510528ms second-round excess cannot be assigned to I/O or any single cause. Its full cost is accepted as observed.

tradeoff_rationale: All three latency gates and complete-output/invariant checks passed independently. No pooled mean, p50 or p95 cell regresses. This permits evaluating startup costs against retained steady-call gains, not replacing a failed numeric gate.

Mean import excess is 3.197244ms on synthetic and 2.99035475ms on public; these are separate cohort observations and must not be added together. Mean public empty-open excess is 5.1004795ms. Candidate means remain near 31ms for import and 29ms for empty-open on this host.

The intended persistent MCP service and repeated native-connection use pay setup once per process/connection. This review accepts those bounded observed setup costs to obtain the measured repeated-query gains; it makes no promise for one-shot CLI workloads.

The existing original rule explicitly calls for cause assessment and independent review when resource means rise above 10%. The added-work paths are identified, uncertainty remains explicit, and every observed excess is retained. Acceptance is a documented product tradeoff, not a claim of complete causal decomposition.

All 28 registered resource comparisons were checked. Only these three trigger review; the other registered resource mean increases remain at or below 10%. The added index has nonzero storage cost, retained in the independent audit.

preserved_adverse_observations.synthetic_outlier_treatment: Retained in original arithmetic and raw records. Not presented as an initialization speed advantage, not discarded, and no cause is established.
